title: Industrial Echo family prototype four-view tool identity
summary: Final prototype checkpoint d0fbcf7 has a hunched legacy biped, stable physical L/R limb IDs, four authored views and Survey/Maintenance right-hand tool variants. Down/up tool position and left/right near/far depth explicitly tested. Fixed 12/13 legs use a 60 percent stance path with 10-design-unit stride metadata. No modern Bearframe emblem or mandatory chest/ear display package. Original native study, not exact Murmur or approved canonical art. Additional families and runtime consumer remain pending.
